findings.title: Retain experimentally supported MG1655 adenine induction of add
findings.finding: The draft represents expression induction for xapA, umpH and deoD, but omits the measured adenine-induced add response in its declared MG1655 scope. Its description mentions only historical E. coli B induction as a nontransferable observation, overlooking independent K-12 MG1655 primary evidence already retained for the shared Add step in the preceding salvage-II record.

primary_source.result: Methods explicitly use K-12 MG1655 and derivatives, M9 with 2 g/L glucose, 37 C, mid-log phase, with or without 100 micrograms/mL adenine. Results sec9 explicitly report 17.61-fold induction of add transcript. Sec13 explicitly excludes add and deoD from direct PurR regulation.

findings.proposed_fix: Add independently verified CHEBI:16708 adenine and Entrez:945851 add gene nodes and an adenine activates add gene-expression edge with this primary reference, exact locators, MG1655 culture scope and no direct binding/allostery/PurR claim. Retain the historical E. coli B scope limit separately. Reuse already retained issuing authority identities only after checking the actual original Gene record and chemical label.
acceptance: Exact added chemical/gene IDs resolve against issuing originals; gene maps to MG1655 b1623 and P22333.
Gene-level induction edge cites PMID21572102 Methods sec3 and Results sec9; sec13 non-PurR limit preserved.
No adenine activates Add protein or PurR directly represses add edge is introduced.
